- i: He went into his dwelling and gave her everything needed: honor and wealth, fine garments that dazzle the eyes, and all that was needed to honor the land of Ethiopia; and mounts (?) and carts, about six thousand (?) of them, laden with the honorable goods that were needed; and carts that carry their loads over sand (?), and a cart that goes on the sea, and a cart that runs upon the winds, which he made according to the wisdom God had given him.
